🎥🩸: The Dog Stars (2026)

In the aftermath of a global catastrophe, a man and his devoted dog navigate a world where every decision can mean the difference between life and death. Living in near-total isolation, he struggles to hold onto his humanity while surrounded by the haunting remnants of civilization.

A chance discovery sends him beyond the safety of his home and into unfamiliar territory, where breathtaking landscapes hide relentless danger. As he encounters new survivors and impossible moral choices, he begins to believe that even after unimaginable loss, hope can still be found.

The Dog Stars is a powerful survival epic filled with emotional stakes, breathtaking visuals, and edge-of-your-seat suspense that explores what it truly means to keep moving forward.

In theaters August 28th

source_details.title: The Dog Stars
source_details.synopsis: The Dog Stars is a 2026 post-apocalyptic action thriller film directed and produced by Ridley Scott, from a screenplay by Mark L. Smith, based on the 2012 novel by Peter Heller. The film stars Jacob Elordi, Josh Brolin, Margaret Qualley, and Guy Pearce, and follows the survivors of a global flu pandemic in rural Colorado. The Dog Stars premiered at the Odeon Luxe Leicester Square on August 20, 2026, and was released in the United States by 20th Century Studios on August 28. The film received mixed reviews from critics, and was a box-office bomb, grossing $39 million against a production budget of $70–110 million.
